heading: EXT. CITY HALL PLAZA - CLIMATE PROTEST - DAY

units.text: EXT. CITY HALL PLAZA - CLIMATE PROTEST - DAY
A sea of cardboard signs and one very large papier-mache polar bear.
Drums thump.
A sky the colour of weak tea.
JEN, 30s, clipboard, megaphone, is losing an argument with SAM, 30s, her ex-fiance, who is carrying an end of the polar bear and walking backwards into a bin.
I'm just saying, the bear's head is crooked.
units.name: SAM

units.text: The bear is perfect, Sam. You're the one holding it wrong.
units.name: JEN

units.text: The bin TOPPLES.
A pigeon explodes upward.

BIG DAVE, 50s, a bear of a man in a full beekeeper suit, catches the bear's falling head with one hand and a falafel in the other, while MRS. K, 70s, tiny, ferocious, in a knitted hat that says NO PLANET B, smacks him with her sign for taking the last wrap and a drone hums overhead, trailing a banner from the city that says PLEASE DISPERSE.
Mrs. K! I'm wearing a bee suit!
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: Then you should have a stinger.
units.name: MRS. K

units.text: A STRANGER, 30s, silver jumpsuit, no sign, no shoes, steps out from behind the bear and stares straight at the sky.
In his hand, a small device that BUZZES.
Who's that?
units.name: JEN

units.text: Your date?
units.name: SAM

units.text: I didn't bring a date.
units.name: JEN

units.text: The stranger crosses to her.
Holds up the device.
It BEEPS twice, green.
Forgive me. I am from two hundred years from now. This is the last place it went right.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Is he with the bear?
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: The stranger turns to Mrs. K, who's squinting at him.
What's your name, dear?
units.name: MRS. K

units.text: Oz. Short for Ozymandias. My mother was a poet.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: I am here to ask you not to stop.
units.name: OZ

units.text: A SQUEAK.
PIP, 12, Jen's niece, pops out from inside the polar bear wearing the head like a helmet.
Aunt Jen? I think I'm stuck.
units.name: PIP

units.text: Everyone turns.
Sam starts to laugh.
Jen starts to laugh.
The drone spins away, confused.
Big Dave offers Oz half the falafel.
In my time, this has been extinct for ninety years.
units.name: OZ

units.text: The falafel?
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: The hope.
units.name: OZ

units.text: Mrs. K pats his arm.
Then eat up, dear. We've got a march.
units.name: MRS. K
